flow.name: axn-term - talk sub-shell resumes devin session by name
flow.description: A git-inspect 'Talk about this' sub-shell tab must resume its devin conversation across an app restart — never re-run the seed prompt.

script.description: Create a temp state dir with a session carrying an active agent talk tab and a fake devin binary
Launch axn-term with the temp state dir
The talk tab spawns and runs the seed prompt; the fallback resume command is persisted

assertions.description: The seeded devin session ran and a resume command was stored

script.description: Type /exit into the talk sub-shell so devin prints its resume hint

assertions.description: The devin session name was captured into the tab's resumeCommand

script.description: Close axn-term so state is persisted

assertions.description: The app closed and saved state

script.description: Reopen axn-term — the talk tab must resume the captured devin session, not re-seed

assertions.description: The tab resumed via devin -r gray-party

flow.name: axn-term - talk sub-shell falls back to devin -c
flow.description: When the app is closed while the talk tab's devin session is still running (no resume hint ever printed), the tab must fall back to 'devin -c' on restart instead of re-seeding.

script.description: Create a temp state dir with a session carrying an active agent talk tab and a fake devin binary
Launch axn-term with the temp state dir
The talk tab spawns and runs the seed prompt; the fallback resume command is persisted

assertions.description: The seeded devin session ran and a resume command was stored

script.description: Close axn-term while devin is still running — no exit hint, only the -c fallback survives

assertions.description: The app closed and saved state

script.description: Reopen axn-term — the talk tab must continue the directory's devin session, not re-seed
